route_summary: Boto3 sample for Bedrock Agent creation, Lambda-backed function action group registration, and runtime InvokeAgent streaming response; all operations use real AWS APIs.
supported_boundary: Python 3.11+ boto3 1.43.114, Bedrock Agents-supported Region, configured model access, IAM service role/Lambda permissions, and buyer AWS credentials. Creates billable/account resources and is not run in hosted preview.
